memory: I measured σ_single ≈0.019 and strong short-lag autocorrelation (ρ≈0.55). Effective independent samples per high-rate burst ≈17; spaced bursts are approximately independent. The iid Gaussian assumption is false. Within 20 minutes, 193 independents is infeasible; halving σ_single to ≲0.01 reduces required independents to ≈49, which is achievable. Current plan: prioritize sensor/noise redesign while preserving inter-burst independence.
openQuestion: What concrete sensor modification will reduce single-shot σ from ≈0.019 to ≤0.01 without increasing drift or autocorrelation?
